stage.note: At least pre-seed: went through Y Combinator (Summer 2023), which invests in every company it takes; no later round found.

note: Opensteer (opensteer.com) is a Y Combinator Summer 2023 (S23) company founded by Tim Jang, based in Los Angeles, per the YC company directory page which matches the provider's domain. The YC page lists only 1 employee and does not disclose any funding round, amount, or investors beyond YC itself; opensteer.com's own homepage says only 'opensteer backed by Y Combinator' with no press/funding page. Crunchbase, HN Algolia, Bing and DuckDuckGo searches for press coverage of a seed/pre-seed round or revenue turned up nothing specific to this company (name collides heavily with the unrelated open-source 'OpenSteer' boids/steering-behavior C++ library, which pollutes search results). Treat funding stage, amount and revenue as unknown pending better sources; only the YC S23 accelerator relationship and independent-startup ownership are confirmed.
